greeting: The calendar is clear today, Dan. The only things asking for you are a couple of replies and the start of Mike's surgery week.

needsAttention.title: Eugenia is waiting on a time
needsAttention.detail: She answered in the PRI thread with slots — Monday 12–2 or Thursday, your time — and needs you to pick one. Monday is tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Start Mike's pre-op checklist
needsAttention.detail: Thursday's oral surgery in Portland is close: pre-op instructions to confirm with the surgeon's office by tomorrow, then a driver and insurance to lock down by Tuesday.

schedule.title: Milica Boskovic's birthday
schedule.detail: A line to send her way

flagged.title: SVP Global Public Policy — interview update
flagged.detail: An applicant-tracking note asks you to confirm work authorization to keep the application moving; the sender (sourcehire.app) is worth verifying before you click anything.

flagged.title: Talkiatry follow-up Tuesday
flagged.detail: Virtual visit with Dr. Snowden, Tuesday Aug 18 at 10:00 AM ET.

flagged.title: Morgan Stanley holdings notice
flagged.detail: A proxy and important-information mailing about your private markets and alternatives holdings.

flagged.title: Mike's Sustainalytics idea
flagged.detail: Mike forwarded news that Morningstar is closing Sustainalytics' stewardship arm and floated reaching out to its stranded clients.

inbox.noise: The rest is promotions and newsletters — Chairish, Domino's, NYT Cooking, WSJ, the New Yorker, and a few shop mailers.

recipe.title: Olive oil–poached zucchini & raw tomatoes
recipe.why: Peak-summer zucchini and just-picked tomatoes, softened slowly in good olive oil — exactly the unhurried supper a quiet Maine evening is asking for.

acts.line: A wide-open Sunday, Dan — nothing on the calendar to shape it.
The middle of the day is yours to spend as you like.
A calm close, with tomorrow's two o'clock call with Mike the only thing on the near horizon.
